title: Depth Sweep

story.briefing: Not how far, just how much. Which parts of the network can the Core still touch from node 0?
story.success: Reach established. The unreachable sections are flagged for the crew.

description: A graph is given as n, the number of nodes numbered 0 to n-1, and edges, an array of [u, v] pairs. Edges are undirected unless stated otherwise, and there are no self-loops or duplicate edges. Return the node numbers reachable from node 0, in increasing order. Node 0 is always reachable from itself.
hints: Depth first or breadth first makes no difference to the answer here — only to the order you happen to visit things, and the output is sorted anyway.
A visited marker per node is what stops you going round a cycle forever. Check it before adding a node, not after taking it out.
Build a neighbour list. Keep a stack seeded with node 0 and a visited array. Pop a node, and push each unvisited neighbour after marking it. Collect the marked nodes in index order at the end.
